summary: Product photo or icon with a caption; the photo drifts slowly (Ken Burns) inside a card or full-bleed

variables.help: photo file (png, jpg, webp), absolute or relative to the video folder; copied into the graphic
used when there is no image: one of check star bolt heart play shield phone gift target clock globe rupee cart, or one short symbol or emoji
card: photo in a frame beside the text; full: photo fills the screen under a shade
cover crops the photo to its frame; contain shows all of it
